results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if project context is ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Action using VERCEL_GET_PROJECT2 (confirm the canonical project); if lookup fails or scope is unclear, discover candidates using VERCEL_GET_PROJECTS.
[Required] [Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS (list recent deployments for the project; follow pagination.next as needed) and select a target deployment uid plus high-level state.
[Required] [Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT (confirm authoritative status/readyState and capture error indicators and promotion signals such as aliasAssigned).
[Required (if readyState is non-terminal)] [Next Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT (poll until readyState becomes terminal, then record the final outcome, including READY/ERROR/CANCELED).
[Required] [Step]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2 (retrieve a small runtime log tail first via maxLogs to reduce truncation/timeouts; increase only if needed).

[Fallback (if logs are empty, time out, or are not diagnostic)] [Fallback]: Action using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2 (fetch a bounded event slice to pinpoint the failing stage and extract actionable lines); if rollout looks gated, confirm via VERCEL_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKS.
known_pitfalls: [VERCEL_GET_PROJECT2] Wrong scope commonly yields 403 Forbidden; downstream deployment/log calls may also fail until the correct scope is used.
[VERCEL_GET_PROJECTS] The limit parameter may validate as a string; type mismatches can trigger request validation errors.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT] Using an incorrect idOrUrl can return 404 not_found; source identifiers from VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2] Can return logs=[] or intermittently fail with HTTP 500 read timeout on large output.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2] Payloads can be very large (e.g., requesting unbounded limits); keep limit/window tight and ensure parameter types validate.

VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS.description: Tool to list deployments from Vercel. Use when you need to retrieve deployment information for a project or team.

to.description: Gets the deployment created before this Date timestamp. (default: current time)

app.description: Name of the deployment to filter by

sha.description: Filter deployments based on the SHA

from.description: Gets the deployment created after this Date timestamp. (default: current time)

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

limit.description: Maximum number of deployments to list from a request

since.description: Get Deployments created after this JavaScript timestamp

state.description: Filter deployments based on their state (BUILDING, ERROR, INITIALIZING, QUEUED, READY, CANCELED)

until.description: Get Deployments created before this JavaScript timestamp

users.description: Filter out deployments based on users who have created the deployment

branch.description: Filter deployments based on the branch name

target.description: Filter deployments based on the environment

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

projectId.description: Filter deployments from the given ID or name

projectIds.description: Filter deployments from the given project IDs. Cannot be used when projectId is specified

rollbackCandidate.description: Filter deployments based on their rollback candidacy

VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT.description: Tool to get a deployment by ID or URL. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific deployment.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

idOrUrl.description: The unique identifier or hostname of the deployment.

withGitRepoInfo.description: Whether to add in gitRepo information.

VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2.description: Tool to retrieve runtime logs for a specific Vercel deployment by project and deployment ID. Use when you need to debug or monitor deployment execution with detailed runtime information.

slug.description: Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

teamId.description: Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

maxLogs.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: 100). The endpoint streams logs, so this limits how many to collect.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the project

deploymentId.description: The unique identifier of the deployment

VERCEL_GET_PROJECT2.description: Tool to find a project by ID or name with comprehensive details. Use when you need complete project metadata including configuration, deployments, security settings, and analytics.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name
